content.text:
Vercel's Pro plan costs **$20/month** as a flat platform fee, according to the official pricing page and docs.

- **Seats:** The fee includes 1 deploying seat. Extra deploying seats (Owner or Member) cost $20/month each. Viewer seats are free and unlimited.
- **Usage credit:** $20/month of usage credit is included. Usage beyond that is pay-as-you-go and uncapped.
- **Included usage:**
  - 10M CDN requests per month, then from $2 per 1M.
  - 1 TB Fast Data Transfer per month, then from $0.15 per GB.
- **Other limits:**
  - Up to 40 custom firewall rules.
  - Runtime logs are kept for 1 day, or 30 days with Observability Plus.

Some third-party sites describe Pro as "$20 per user". The official docs describe a flat $20 fee plus $20 for each extra deploying seat. Prices change, so check vercel.com/pricing before you budget.

Sources:
- [Vercel Pricing](https://vercel.com/pricing)
- [Vercel Pro Plan docs](https://docs.vercel.com/docs/plans/pro-plan)
- [Pricing on Vercel](https://docs.vercel.com/docs/pricing)
